name: William Meek

work_experience.title: Chief Financial Officer
work_experience.description: Served as CFO of Mercury NZ (formerly Mighty River Power) for approximately 15 years. Headed the finance, treasury, legal, and investor relations functions. Previously also responsible for generation investment strategy and enterprise risk functions. Stepped down at end of March 2025 after three decades with the company.

work_experience.title: Finance Executive
work_experience.description: Joined Mercury (then Mighty River Power) in 1999. Held senior finance roles for approximately a decade before becoming CFO. Had 15 years of industry experience in risk management, power development, wholesale markets and forecasting prior to the CFO role.

work_experience.title: Director / Board Member
work_experience.description: Served as Director/Board Member of Mercury Energy Ltd, a subsidiary providing power and gas distribution services.

work_experience.title: Director / Board Member
work_experience.description: Served as Director on the board of Intellihub Ltd, a wholesale distributor selling generators and other industrial equipment.

work_experience.title: Director / Board Member
work_experience.description: Served as Director of Rotokawa Generation Ltd, which owns geothermal generation plant assets.

work_experience.title: Director / Board Member

major_achievements.achievement: 宣布在担任Mercury CFO 15年、服务公司30年后离任：在与Mercury共事三十年并担任CFO 15年后，Meek确认将于2025年3月底离任以陪伴家人。Mercury感谢其对公司成功的巨大贡献，包括IPO以来的一贯出色表现以及成功完成Tilt Renewables和Trustpower零售交易

biography_summary: 威廉·米克（William Thomas Meek）曾任水星新西兰有限公司（Mercury NZ Limited）首席财务官，在新西兰能源行业拥有超过三十年的深厚经验。米克于1999年加入水星公司（当时名为 Mighty River Power），在成为首席财务官之前，长期负责风险管理、电力开发、批发市场和预测等核心业务领域，积累了十五年的行业实务经验。约自2009年起，他正式担任首席财务官一职，全面负责公司的财务、资金管理、法律事务和投资者关系等关键职能，同时还曾主管发电投资战略和企业风险管理。在担任首席财务官的十五年间，米克对公司的发展做出了重大贡献，特别是公司在首次公开募股（IPO）后的持续优异业绩表现，以及成功完成 Tilt Renewables 和 Trustpower 零售业务等重大交易。此外，米克还在水星公司旗下的多家子公司担任董事职务，包括水星能源有限公司（Mercury Energy）、罗托卡瓦发电公司（Rotokawa Generation）、智能枢纽有限公司（Intellihub）和韦弗利风力发电场（Waverley Wind Farm）等逾二十家关联企业，展现了广泛的公司治理经验。米克毕业于奥克兰大学。2023年12月，他宣布将于2025年3月底离职，以便有更多时间陪伴家人。

collection_meta.notes: William Thomas Meek served as CFO of Mercury NZ Limited for approximately 15 years (c.2009-2025) after joining the company in 1999. Full name William Thomas Meek confirmed from MarketScreener. Stepped down at end of March 2025. Educated at University of Auckland. Based in Auckland. Held directorships at 20+ Mercury subsidiary companies. Birth date not publicly available. No current positions as he has stepped down from Mercury.
